name: Browse the VYRA collection and filter looks
description: Checks the editorial homepage, collection cards, and search results.
steps: Open the VYRA homepage
Open search and enter Ruby Reverie
Search for a term with no matches
expected: The collection filters to Ruby Reverie and shows a clear empty state for an unmatched search.

name: Submit a customer availability request
description: Checks that a customer can request availability for selected looks and receives a request reference.
steps: Open the collection on a mobile viewport
Add a look to the bag
Refresh the page and reopen the bag
Enter valid contact and delivery details
Submit the availability request
expected: The selected look remains in the bag after refresh, the request is saved, and the customer sees a confirmation reference.

name: Reject invalid customer request details
description: Checks that incomplete contact and delivery details cannot create an order request.
steps: Add a look to the bag
Open the bag
Leave the phone number or delivery address empty
Submit the request
expected: The browser blocks the incomplete form and no request is created.

name: Restrict order management to the app owner
description: Checks that the private order dashboard requires owner sign-in and lets the owner update request status.
steps: Open the Owner link while signed out
Attempt to view orders
Sign in with the AppDeploy app-owner account
Change one request from New to Contacted
expected: Signed-out visitors cannot read orders; the owner can view requests and update their status.

name: Preserve product and order request details
description: Checks that a request stores each selected look and the supplied customer details for later follow-up.
steps: Add two different looks to the bag
Submit an availability request with customer details
Sign in as the owner and open the order dashboard
expected: The dashboard shows the customer's contact details and both requested looks.

name: Open a product detail page and request availability
description: Verifies a customer can open a product detail page, inspect its image gallery, and add the product to the availability request bag.
covers: product image gallery with four images
steps: Open the VYRA collection
Open Ruby Reverie using View Product
Verify four gallery images
Choose size XL
Choose Order Now
expected: The Ruby Reverie detail page shows four gallery images and an XS–XXL size selector; Order Now adds the selected size to the request bag.

name: Browse product details on mobile
description: Verifies product detail content and gallery controls remain usable on a mobile viewport.
steps: Open the VYRA collection on mobile
Open Amethyst Afterglow product details
Select the second product image
Close the product page
expected: The product detail page stacks the gallery and details vertically, the second image can be selected, and the customer returns to the collection.
